subject: OptiMed pilot: readout booking, acceptance checklist & contract motion
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@optimed.com>, Rajiv Sharma <rajiv.sharma@optimed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, marcus_lin@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-11T14:12:00-04:00
Subject: RE: Post-demo follow-up & next steps

Claire / Rajiv — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we all have the same view heading into the pilot: 

Summary of agreement from today’s call: 
- 4-week pilot (7/19 start) focused on Clinical Note Summarization and Triage routing.
- Success criteria (high-level): 
  * ≥85% clinician accept rate on summaries in week 4 (measured by sampled review)
  * End-to-end latency below 750ms 95th pct for triage path
  * No PHI persisted outside your VPC (we will run Redwood Private tenant)
- Redwood will provide a shared dashboard, a weekly quality snapshot, and a short eval script for your reviewers.

Ownership & responsibilities: 
- OptiMed: clinical reviewer pool (min 6), procurement contact (Rajiv) for SOW/PO.
- Redwood: pilot environment (private deployment), weekly snapshot reporting (Marcus), technical onboarding/observability (Karthik).

Attachments: I’ve attached a starting POC success matrix (OptiMed_POC_success_matrix.xlsx) and a draft SOW for procurement to review (SOW_Redwood_v1.2.pdf).

Immediate asks / next steps: 
1) Confirm pilot start date (we propose 7/19).
2) Confirm exec readout attendee list and preferred times for the final readout week (options below).
3) Rajiv: please confirm procurement timelines for SOW + PO issuance (target before 7/23).

Proposed final readout window (we will reserve a 45-min slot): 
- Tue 8/17 10:00–10:45 ET
- Wed 8/18 14:00–14:45 ET
- Thu 8/19 09:00–09:45 ET

If those don’t work, tell us 2 alternatives and we’ll adapt.

Thanks — I’ll hold the pilot environment prep tasks until we confirm start/PO status.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@optimed.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv.sharma@optimed.com>
Date: 2027-07-11T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo follow-up & next steps

Thanks Grace — this is great and aligns with our internal notes. Quick responses inline: 

- Pilot start: 7/19 works for our clinical team.
- Success criteria: the three bullets look right — we can add a secondary quality metric for hallucination rate (target ≤2% on sampled prompts).
- Reviewer pool: I’ll own recruiting the 6 clinical reviewers; Rajiv is copied for procurement.

Procurement (Rajiv): we need the SOW and an estimated line-item price to get through our internal review this week. Can you also attach a brief security checklist for our InfoSec folks?

Readout attendees: I expect the following will join final readout — CEO Tim Lee, CIO (TBD), myself, and Rajiv. Any chance we can aim for Wed 8/18 14:00 ET? That would be ideal.

Claire
Claire Dawson
Head of Product Innovation, OptiMed Solutions

Looping in CS and Sales leadership to confirm the readout playbook and contract motion. A couple notes from the ops side: 

- I’ll own the weekly quality snapshot and will drop a template into the shared Drive by EOD Monday (includes sampling plan and hallucination check).
- Karthik: please prepare an onboarding checklist for the Private deployment (networking/VPC peering, KMS keys, and audit log endpoints). We need that to attach to the SOW for Rajiv.
- Lauren: prepare a quick runbook for the exec readout — 20 minutes of findings, 15 minutes of open discussion, 10 minutes decision/go-no-go. We should capture a recommended motion (extend to prod, move to SOW exec, or no-go).

Rishi — if OptiMed signs PO before 7/23 we should be able to keep the 7/19 start date and guarantee the readout slots listed by Grace. If procurement slides, we’ll need to postpone by one week.

I’m attaching a snapshot mock (POC_dashboard_qc.png) so you can see the data layout I plan to use.

Marcus
Director, Customer Success

> On Jul 11, 2027, Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@optimed.com> wrote:
> > (confirmation message)
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Dawson <claire.dawson@optimed.com>, Tim Lee <tim.lee@optimed.com>
Cc: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv.sharma@optimed.com>, marcus_lin@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-12T10:05:00-04:00
Subject: Final: Wed 8/18 14:00 ET confirmed — readout agenda & decision options

Claire / Tim / Rajiv — thanks for confirming. Per Claire’s preference, we’ve booked Wed 8/18 14:00–14:45 ET for the final pilot readout. Agenda and decision framework below so attendees can prep: 

Agenda (45 minutes):
- 0–3 min: Welcome & objective framing (Grace)
- 3–23 min: Pilot outcomes & quality highlights (Marcus)
- 23–33 min: Latency/cost/ops review (Karthik)
- 33–40 min: Customer feedback + open questions (Claire / Tim)
- 40–45 min: Decision motion and next steps (Rishi / Rajiv)

Decision options we will present (select one during the meeting):
A) Approve production rollout & sign production SOW (target: Q3 onboarding)
B) Approve extended pilot for additional business lines (4–8 weeks; requires updated scope)
C) No-go: stop pilot, provide post-mortem with root causes and recommended fixes

Pre-read (sent): POC success matrix, draft SOW, dashboard mock. Please review the POC spreadsheet and flag any missing acceptance tests by 7/15 so Marcus and I can incorporate them.

Rajiv — procurement suggested a soft PO before 7/23 to lock in the 7/19 start. If there’s any barrier we should know about, please escalate to your legal/procurement lead so we can surface alternative contracting approaches (short-term trial agreement, purchase order, or MSA addendum).

Logistics: Zoom invite sent separately from calendar.

Thanks — looking forward to a strong pilot.

Best,
Grace
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
